passages.text: Plants of the World Online account: Schoenoplectiella erecta (Poir.) Lye.

The native range of this species is Iberian Peninsula Sahel to S. Africa, Mascarenes, N. India to Indo-China, SE. U.S.A. to Mexico, S. South America. It is an annual and grows primarily in the seasonally dry tropical biome.
